github_flow.template: Execute the GitHub Flow: 1) git add <files>, 2) git commit -m "<message>", 3) git push -u origin <current-branch>, 4) create a PR via GitHub CLI or web, 5) accept/merge the PR to main, 6) keep the branch (do NOT delete remote branch), 7) git checkout main && git pull origin main to update local main.
github_flow.description: Execute full GitHub Flow: add, commit, push, PR, merge, keep branch, update local main
